learning_outcomes.text: Understand the general concepts of Artificial Vision and use basic operations for digital image processing.
Identify relevant properties and extract different features from digital images.
Design, implement, and validate Artificial Vision systems for image segmentation and pattern recognition.
Design, implement, and validate convolutional neural networks for solving advanced Artificial Vision problems.

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 4 out of 10 points must be obtained in both the theoretical and practical parts. If these minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum between 4 and the grade obtained from the weighted average. The ordinary examination consists of 5% attendance, 10% online participation, 45% practical work, and 40% theory exam. For extraordinary examinations, the evaluation consists of a 50% theory exam and a 50% practical exam, with a minimum of 4 points required in each part. If a student obtained 5 or higher in a part (theory or practical) in the ordinary call, they can only be evaluated on the part not previously passed.
